subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search treat an unavailable explicitly configured `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` SecretRef as authoritative and fail closed even when ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is available?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible: fail-closed avoids silently routing a configured setup through an unrelated ambient cloud credential, while fallback preserves prior ambient-key behavior for existing mixed environments. Repository policy treats fallback and provider configuration changes as product decisions.

options.title: Adopt explicit-ref fail-closed behavior
options.body: Merge the intended policy after current-head proof confirms unavailable configured refs make zero requests and mixed configured/ambient fallback remains intact.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Revise the PR so an unavailable configured SecretRef may fall through to ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY`, then add focused tests and wording for that compatibility contract.

options.title: Pause for broader credential-policy guidance
options.body: Hold this PR until Ollama owner guidance defines precedence consistently across configured and ambient credentials.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit-ref fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the intended policy after current-head proof confirms unavailable configured refs make zero requests and mixed configured/ambient fallback remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion specifically requests this owner-level compatibility decision and no current-main feature-history owner could be verified from the provided read-only context.
